en: Let's see how well we've raised our Pokémon!
Great! If we're this strong, Team Plasma will run screaming the moment they see us!
I won't let them get away this time, though. Her Purrloin... I'll get it back, for sure!
So, {player}, keep helping me out! And keep working on the Pokédex, too! You're the one who was officially asked to complete it, after all!
